concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII mandates a strict 80% train / 20% held-out test split with no batch/source leakage. No task creates this split or performs a final held-out evaluation; T004–T006 implement only 5-fold GroupKFold CV. Add a task for the group-aware 80/20 split and held-out evaluation, or reconcile the constitution.

FR-002 specifies the Full-vs-Null permutation statistic as 'RMSE change'; T006 uses 'ΔR² as the statistic'. This is a semantic weakening/contradiction of the FR — align the task with the spec's stated statistic (or amend the spec).

FR-006 explicitly excludes interaction terms from the VIF check ('This check excludes interaction terms to avoid flagging structural collinearity'), yet T003 computes and reports interaction VIFs. Computing them even as 'diagnostics only' contradicts the FR; drop interaction VIFs from the task or amend FR-006.

T003 requires residualizing each interaction column against its main effects. Neither FR-002 nor the data model (InteractionFeature = 'a product of two base predictors') authorizes this transformation; it silently changes what the interaction features are. Document it in the spec/data model or remove it.

The constitution requires a pinned requirements.txt/pyproject.toml at code/ for the isolated-venv execution; no task creates or verifies this file. Add a setup task (or fold into T001) delivering the pinned dependency file.

concerns.text: Plan places code under src/pipeline/ and tests under tests/; every task writes to code/pipeline/ and code/tests/. Pick one layout so task verification paths match the plan's structure.
T007 tags SC-005 for the SHAP driver ranking, but SC-005 is the Jaccard-stability criterion delivered by T008. Correct the traceability tag.
